mapper.select: SELECT FROM license ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM license WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM license WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT FROM license WHERE machine_code = #{machineCode} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM license WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO license (license_key, machine_code, product_id, order_id, user_id, device_id, sign, license_type, status, issued_at, activated_at, expires_at, revoked_at) VALUES (#{licenseKey}, #{machineCode}, #{productId}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{deviceId}, #{sign}, #{licenseType}, #{status}, #{issuedAt}, #{activatedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE license SET status = #{status}, activated_at = COALESCE(#{activatedAt}, activated_at), revoked_at = COALESCE(#{revokedAt}, revoked_at) WHERE id = #{id}
